retry_policy_source: overlay/benchflow/evaluation.py RetryConfig.max_retries=2; _run_task retries only retryable agent/verifier errors, not low rewards. Inherited original CLI default; no retry-option change.
cap_clarification: Audit external cap is2 outer attempt directories per condition; unchanged executor can internally retry up to2 further times for qualifying infrastructure/idle/API errors. Report actual inner executions separately; do not describe outer count as model execution count.
selection_rule: Adjudicate each distinct rollout independently. Do not reject an outer group solely because it has multiple separate result files; official unique result requirement applies per rollout. Final chosen inner rollout must be explicitly recorded, with earlier raw errors retained. No normal valid failure retried for score.
